journey.name: Bark toggle is gated by spending balance
journey.description: Precondition: onboarded signet wallet with a non-zero spending balance, Ark disabled.

actions.action: Verify that the wallet home screen shows a non-zero Spending balance
Verify that a "Use Ark (experimental)" row with a switch is visible
Verify that a dialog titled "Can't Switch Yet" is shown, that it says the spending balance must be moved to savings first, and that it offers a "Transfer To Savings" action
Verify that the app is on a transfer to savings screen
